name: Manual Trigger — Autonomous Refactoring Workflow (WF2)
description: Manually triggers the WF2 Autonomous Refactoring workflow to refactor legacy code while preserving behavior

then.prompt: Execute the WF2 Autonomous Refactoring workflow following the wf2-autonomous-refactoring skill steps exactly: 1) Analyze legacy code to identify technical debt, code smells, and refactoring opportunities. 2) Create a restore point using git-rollback MCP create_restore_point. 3) Apply refactoring using modern patterns from references/refactoring-patterns.md. 4) Run existing tests using git-rollback MCP verify_consistency — rollback on failure. 5) Verify behavior equivalence using scripts/compare_behavior.py. 6) Run performance benchmarks using scripts/run_benchmarks.py. 7) Run security scan using security-scanner MCP scan_code. 8) Generate a delta report. 9) Log all results to audit-logger MCP. If any checkpoint fails, STOP, report failure details, and rollback using git-rollback MCP.
